tour.title: Project Architecture & Mission
tour.description: Start with the project documentation and interactive architecture diagram to understand GroundMark's mission: high-fidelity document layout analysis, OCR visual reading order, and conversational question answering.

tour.title: Document Ingestion & Preprocessing
tour.description: Learn how raw documents enter the system: PDFs are rasterized into page images, normalized, deskewed, and base64 encoded for multimodal LLM vision ingestion.

tour.title: Layout Extraction & Bounding Box Detection
tour.description: Examine the layout engine that predicts bounding boxes (BBox), identifies columns, headers, list items, and table structures across document pages.

tour.title: Markdown Serialization & Table Reconstruction
tour.description: See how structured bounding boxes and cell coordinates are reconstituted into clean GitHub Flavored Markdown and HTML tables.

tour.title: Visual Annotation & Overlay Rendering
tour.description: Explore how extracted bounding boxes and reading order paths are rendered directly back onto PDF and PNG document pages for human inspection.

tour.title: State Graph & Pipeline Orchestration
tour.description: Discover how the state machine coordinates the end-to-end execution flow from raw file input to parsed artifacts, error boundaries, and telemetry.

tour.title: Model Access & Diagnostics Telemetry
tour.description: Inspect the low-level OpenAI model clients, prompt management, token cost accounting, and content filter safety diagnostics.

tour.title: Conversational Q&A & Citation Verification
tour.description: Understand how GroundMark answers complex questions over documents using multi-turn chat with strict statement-level citation verification.

tour.title: Interactive Web UI
tour.description: Tour the Streamlit frontend that provides side-by-side document inspection, bounding box debugging overlays, and real-time chat.

tour.title: Evaluation Benchmarks & Test Suite
tour.description: Review the evaluation harnesses and automated test suite benchmarking layout IoU, prompt variations, and resolution latency trade-offs.
